title: Web App Threat Monitor v2
description: Improved version of the IBM assessment dashboard: complex_log.csv baseline + labelled attack simulation (index web_lab).

options.query: index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access | stats count AS Requests
index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access | stats count(eval(status_code>=400)) AS e count AS n | eval "Error rate %"=round(100*e/n,1) | fields "Error rate %"
index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access status_code=401 | stats count AS "Failed logins"

| makeresults | where 1=0 | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access resource="/login" status_code=401 | bin _time span=10m | stats count BY _time client_ip | where count>=20] | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access status_code=404 | bin _time span=5m | stats dc(resource) AS d BY _time client_ip | where d>=10] | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access (resource="/admin" OR resource="/api/*") | bin _time span=30m | stats count(eval(status_code=403)) AS d count(eval(status_code>=200 AND status_code<300 AND (method="DELETE" OR method="PUT"))) AS o BY _time client_ip | where d>=5 AND o>=1] | stats count AS "Detections fired"
index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access | eval class=substr(tostring(status_code),1,1)."xx" | bin _time span=15m | stats count BY _time class | xyseries _time class count | fillnull value=0

| makeresults | eval detection="none" | where 1=0 | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access resource="/login" status_code=401 | bin _time span=10m | stats count AS evidence BY _time client_ip | where evidence>=20 | eval detection="D005 Login brute force", detail=evidence." failed logins in 10 min"] | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access status_code=404 | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS n dc(resource) AS evidence BY _time client_ip | where evidence>=10 | eval detection="D007 Content discovery", detail=evidence." distinct missing paths, ".n." 404s in 5 min"] | append [search index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access (resource="/admin" OR resource="/api/*") | bin _time span=30m | stats count(eval(status_code=403)) AS d count(eval(status_code>=200 AND status_code<300 AND (method="DELETE" OR method="PUT"))) AS evidence BY _time client_ip | where d>=5 AND evidence>=1 | eval detection="D008 Admin denied then modified", detail=d." x 403 then ".evidence." successful DELETE/PUT"] | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%F %T") | table Time detection client_ip detail | rename detection AS Detection, client_ip AS "Client IP", detail AS Evidence
index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access status_code=404 | stats count AS "404s" dc(resource) AS "Distinct paths" BY client_ip | sort - "404s" | head 8 | rename client_ip AS "Client IP"

index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access | eval client_type=case(match(user_agent,"(?i)curl|postman|python|nikto|sqlmap"),"Scripted / tool",true(),"Browser") | stats count BY client_type status_code | xyseries status_code client_type count | fillnull value=0 | rename status_code AS Status
index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access resource="/admin" | stats count BY method status_code | xyseries method status_code count | fillnull value=0 | rename method AS Method

index=web_lab sourcetype=web:access (user_agent="curl*" OR user_agent="Postman*" OR user_agent="python*") (method=DELETE OR method=PUT) resource IN ("/admin","/api/user") status_code>=200 status_code<300 | stats count AS Requests values(method) AS Methods values(resource) AS Endpoints BY client_ip | sort - Requests | rename client_ip AS "Client IP"
